title: IBS and gut-brain disorders in clinical practice
summary: Join GI Dr. Omar Khokhar for an interactive discussion on managing gut-brain disorders in clinic
body_markdown:
In this practical and informative webinar, Dr. Khokhar discusses:


- A simple bedside test for visceral hypersensitivity using a hot or cold drink
- Where pain perception can break down (gut, spinal cord, brain) and what that means for treatment
- How diet, the microbiome, and ultra-processed foods influence DGBI symptoms
- Practical advice on fiber, sleep hygiene, stress, medication review, and pelvic floor health
- When to consider SIBO and SIFO testing, and where the evidence stands on stool microbiome panels
- Why gut-directed hypnotherapy is increasingly a first-line option, especially for older patients.
‍


### Chapters:


0:00 - Welcome and introduction to Dr. Omar Khokhar


2:00 - Why disorders of gut-brain interaction matter


7:00 - Visceral hypersensitivity and how pain perception breaks down


15:00 - The gut microbiome explained


18:00 - Diet, ultra-processed foods, and the 72-hour challenge


28:00 - The microbiome's influence on appetite, sleep, mood and athletic performance


35:30 - Treatment options and gut-directed hypnotherapy


43:00 - Special focus on older adults


51:00 - Key takeaways


52:30 - Audience Q&A
